questions.prompt: She ___ cooking ugali. (A are, B is, C will)
steps: She is a singular subject; is cooking is present continuous.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: Amina and Juma ___ fighting in our class. (A They, B am, C are)
steps: Two named people require the plural auxiliary are.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: I ___ reading a story book. (A am, B is, C has)
steps: I takes the auxiliary am.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: Those ___ chairs. (A are, B is, C have)
steps: Those refers to several chairs, so use are.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: He ___ in class two. (A are, B am, C is)
steps: He takes is in the present tense.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: A bird ___ wings. Use has or have.
steps: A bird is a singular third-person subject.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: We ___ food at home. Use has or have.
steps: We takes have.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: I ___ many friends. Use has or have.
steps: I takes have.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: It ___ a big meat. Use has or have.
steps: It takes has, and meat is normally uncountable.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.
questions.answer: Has; better wording: It has a big piece of meat.

questions.prompt: Do you ___ any fruit? Use has or have.
steps: After do, use the base verb have.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: Write the opposite of Short.
steps: Use tall for height or long for length; context is not supplied.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: Write the opposite of Young.
steps: Old contrasts with young in age.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: Write the opposite of Beautiful.
steps: Ugly is the usual vocabulary antonym.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: Write the opposite of Battom (printed; intended bottom).
steps: The printed typo appears to mean bottom, whose opposite is top.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: Write the opposite of Close.
steps: The meaning is not specified. Choose the opposite appropriate to closing a door or to nearby distance.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: What is the name of the farmer?
steps: The heading names Mr. George; the passage misspells it Geore.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: What vegetables grow in Mr. George's farm?
steps: The passage lists these three vegetables.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: Where does Mr. George live?
steps: The opening says he lives in Arusha; Sanawari is where he farms.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: What fruit trees grow on Mr. George's farm?
steps: The passage names mangoes, apples and oranges.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: How many vowel letters are in spinach?
steps: Spell s-p-i-n-a-c-h and count its vowel letters.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.
